text:
maya: Quick sync — Velora (EdgeXC board) gave greenlight for a 6-week sneak onramp. NDA was signed last night. Need to align bench plan, telemetry toggles, and marketplace packaging. High-level plan: weeks 1-2: env bringup + telemetry, weeks 3-4: benchmarks + tuning, week 5: marketplace image, week 6: partner review + soft launch. Who can do 30m tomorrow 10am PT?

arjun: Nice — couple of asks up front: can we set acceptance gates around p95 latency and average watts under load? Also confirm access method (SSH vs prebuilt image). I'm +1 for 10am.

luke: I can own the bench harness. Will need HW creds and the sample model list. Suggest we test llm-1.3b, llm-7b, and a convo-chat workload. Also need perf counters — vendor thermal/power API or an `ipmitool` endpoint.

susan: Legal note: NDA includes embargo until Velora sign-off + 14 days. No joint announcement until that window. Marketing will need at least 2 weeks prep.

katie: Security: confirm KMS for any keys and whether telemetry includes MAC addresses. We must have anonymized telemetry by default. cc @maya

maya: Good catch @katie — Velora said their agent can be toggled. We'll request telemetry anonymization. @luke I uploaded the initial model tar to /s/velora-test/models — can you confirm runner compatibility?

luke: I see the upload. Will verify runtime compat tonight. For power: partner said they expose a REST endpoint on the lab at `http://10.0.0.5:9001/power`. I'll need the lab VPN creds.

arjun: Velora contact is Sam — I've DM'd the lab creds link. Reminder: lab hours are timeboxed (120 hours). Prioritize smoke + perf.

infra-bot: deploy: benchmark-harness v0.3 deployed to staging at 2026-03-20 03:12 UTC

luke: Great. I'll run initial single-node runs tomorrow AM and post logs. Output snippet format:```
run: ./bench --model llm-1.3b --seq 512 --batch 1 --mode perf
metrics: tokens/s, p50, p95, p99, watt
```

maya: Marketing ask: @ella will want a one-pager for the partner page. Ella — can you draft by Friday?

katie: I'll start the NDA redline checklist; need to double-check export control clause. ETA EOD Thursday.

susan: Add this to legal checklist: "no benchmark numbers in public materials until Velora signs off."

arjun: Ops: we need a marketplace image spec. If we produce a VM/AMI, list kernel, driver, and libc versions. Luke, can we freeze on driver 525.60 for the onramp?

luke: Driver 525.60 is fine. We'll test quantized path (Q4_4) plus FP16. Planning to run both branches `edge-rc-2` and `main` as Velora requested.

maya: Who will own partner sync notes and action items?

arjun: I can take notes for sprint 0 and sprint 1. We'll rotate the owner after that.

maya: Key action items for tomorrow's meeting: 1) bench schedule + owners, 2) telemetry config file (anonymized by default), 3) marketplace spec stub, 4) legal checklist redlines. Meeting confirmed 10am PT — invite sent.

luke: I'll bring the initial bench script and a short results table (baseline runs).

susan: I'll join for the 10m legal check to confirm embargo; might leave early for another call.

katie: Small FYI — Velora asked to test two release branches; document that and ensure release artifacts are reproducible.

luke: Will run quick A/B between `edge-rc-2` and `main` and post diffs.

maya: Thanks team. :thumbsup: We'll follow up here after the sync with concrete run times and the first logs.

arjun: After meeting I'll post the lab creds link and a simple schedule table.

luke: One more infra note — I'll scrub MAC addresses and other PII client-side before uploading telemetry to S3.

katie: Legal reminder — do not store raw MAC/IMEI in S3. Use salted hashes.

maya: Perfect. If nothing else, see you 10am.
